'''Ullullu''' was a tree spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who caught falling Ewoks in her branches; Ewoks called her name when falling. "Ullullu" was a popular name given to female Ewoks.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ullullu was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
